stories.headline: The power of good enough
stories.dek:
I’m not sure about you, but I think I’ve had enough of trying to optimize everything.
A few days ago I saw one post on LinkedIn giving me 8 Simple Ways to Start a Business. I let out a sigh. Then less than a minute later, another post, 6 Simple Steps to Improve My Life. I thought my life was alright
